diagnostics.shrinkage_method: ledoit_wolf_constant_corr + RF-R2 escalation (delta 0.37->0.95) + eigenvalue-floor ridge (cond# target <480)
diagnostics.sigma_caveat: N=239 ~ T=227 -> sample cov singular (cond# 1.18e18). LW analytic shrink alone insufficient (991 > 500), required RF-R2 escalation to delta=0.95 + eigen-floor to reach cond# 480 < 500 PSD. Sigma is HEAVILY regularized (~95% constant-correlation prior) -> usable as coarse risk-budget/ranking overlay, NOT a reliable name-level covariance estimate (Codex R2 accepted). DPL does NOT require this Sigma as a hard input (net-Sharpe learned end-to-end); supplied for optional covariance-aware regularization only.

panel_pca.interpretation: 98f panel has NO dominant common factor (PC1 only 10%) -> feature diversity genuine, low collinear-mode overfit risk for DPL.

residual_orthogonality.method: per-month cross-sectional OLS residualization of each new feature against [S01_Size, 5 value axes, log(adv) liquidity] style axes; metrics: (a) residual var share retained, (b) residual max|corr| vs RAW base90, (c) era-stability of raw corr vs argmax-base, (d) unique var = 1 - top5-PC communality, (e) SAME-BASIS residual max|corr| (both new AND base90 residualized on identical style axes — Codex R1 fair comparator).
residual_orthogonality.sector_neutralization_limitation: EXPLICIT UNRESOLVED LIMITATION (Codex R1 accepted): DPL panel has no sector/industry column; only size+value+liquidity style controls applied. Sector co-movement could inflate true panel correlation. Security-level sector neutralization is impossible from the sanctioned panel input -> NOT a closed claim. Reported as 'orthogonal to available style axes', not 'genuinely orthogonal'.

PIOTROSKI__lvl.verdict: ORTHOGONAL to available style axes — 87.5% variance survives neutralization, same-basis residual corr 0.24 (≈ raw 0.21), 86% idiosyncratic, era corr stable&modest. Fair comparator confirms.

MOHANRAM__lvl.verdict: ORTHOGONAL & decaying-corr (0.32->0.06 increasingly independent) — 96% variance survives, 96% idiosyncratic. Coverage 18.6% caveat stands (signal in low-BM subset).

NETISSUE__lvl.verdict: ORTHOGONAL & stable — 93% survives, same-basis residual corr 0.30, negative stable corr vs reversal (consistent issuance-reversal economics), 95% idiosyncratic.

RESIDMOM__lvl.verdict: REDUNDANT IN PANEL — same-basis residual corr 0.865 (HIGHER than raw 0.78, redundancy confirmed under fair test), only 39.5% idiosyncratic, era corr rock-stable 0.84-0.87 across ALL eras vs M05_Trended_Mom. Confirms alpha RF-A-c2-2 (cycle1 orthogonality was vs R05 BOOK not feature PANEL). RISK RECOMMENDS DROP from DPL panel.

tail_risk.metric_type: proxy (EW candidate basket monthly, pre-lockbox; NOT the DPL portfolio)
tail_risk.interpretation: GPD shape xi=0.23 > 0 -> heavy-tailed; Hill alpha 2.69 (<3) -> fat left tail typical KR equity. ES95 -13.3% monthly on EW basket.
tail_risk.dpl_relevance_caveat: EW basket tail is a candidate-POOL regime warning, NOT a bound on optimized DPL weights (which can reduce OR amplify tail) — Codex R4 accepted. RECOMMEND: optimizer/forge report the DPL-WEIGHTED portfolio ES/CVaR before any tail metric enters a graduation decision; consider an ES/CVaR penalty in the DPL objective (advisory, does NOT override DPL net-Sharpe).

regime_correlation.note: Cross-sectional dispersion HIGHER in RALLY (0.152) than CRISIS (0.121) -> KR crisis correlation spike (names move together, dispersion compresses). DPL trained on full sample may under-hedge crisis co-movement. CRISIS n=14 small -> regime-conditional Sigma noisy; pooled Sigma used (reproducibility over thin bootstrap, per risk-style).

factor_correlation_warnings: RESIDMOM__lvl vs M05_Trended_Mom__lvl: raw 0.847, same-basis residual 0.865, era-stable 0.84-0.87 -> persistent collinearity (RF-R5).

Risk inputs: (1) covariance.parquet cond# 480 PSD but ~95% shrunk -> use only for optional covariance-aware DPL variant, NOT as fine covariance; (2) PRUNE RESIDMOM__lvl + 4 __slp from panel (collinear/noise -> overfit) -> recommended DPL panel = base90 + PIOTROSKI__lvl + MOHANRAM__lvl + NETISSUE__lvl = ~93f; (3) report DPL-WEIGHTED portfolio ES95 alongside net-Sharpe, consider ES/CVaR penalty; (4) crisis co-movement: cross-sec dispersion compresses in CRISIS -> Sharpe-only DPL may under-hedge -> subperiod-min guard (already in calmar/oos_retention gates); (5) crowding usable as RANK only (momentum most volume-crowded), absolute scores invalid for threshold.
dpl_handoff.ceiling_view_from_risk: Risk-side honest assessment: nothing in the risk structure suggests a ceiling BREAKOUT. NECESSARY condition met: the 3 new features ARE orthogonal to available style axes (resid var 0.87-0.96, same-basis residual corr 0.24-0.30) so they add independent information -> refutes the 'no new info' worry. BUT NOT SUFFICIENT: orthogonal information + weak long-side transfer (alpha top20 active t 0.7-1.4) + fat tail (ES95 -13.3%) + KR crisis correlation spike + avg-pairwise-corr 0.156 common-mode floor (long-only cannot diversify below) jointly BOUND the marginal Sharpe DPL can extract. Risk verdict: SR 2.5 NOT supported by risk structure; 1.74 breakout UNPROVEN. Independent triangulation: alpha + alpha-Codex + risk + risk-Codex all converge on cautious-ceiling. Definitive judgment = optimizer full DPL sweep (forge-authoritative), outside risk scope.
